extracted.name: Quick and Easy Mock Hollandaise Sauce
extracted.description: This easy mock hollandaise sauce uses mayonnaise and sour cream with lemon, mustard, and paprika to make a delicious substitute for the real thing.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon prepared yellow mustard, or to taste
instruction_lines: Whisk together mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, mustard, paprika, and hot pepper sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm, 2 to 3 minutes.
